subject: Restore the selected door-pass walk action after speed transition
description: When a selected door-pass speed transition retires into a concrete distance-motion order, ActiveDoorPass now rebinds its mirrored current action to that installed successor. Original has one order list; Rust's stale transition mirror previously overrode the final 1.6 movement units with the wrong sprite row. Nescafe Profile_001 Savegame_001 replay-003 clears frame 1090 and advances to the independent Wait-to-HitCmd handoff at frame 1636; focused coverage passes.
